home.title: EPS: ticketing for every event organiser
home.lead: One platform, each organiser's own brand. Organisers sign up on their own, hold several brands and describe what they sell in EPS Studio; the platform fee is public and every price is shown all-in.

fees.title: Platform fees
fees.lead: One public fee for every organiser. Fans always see the all-in price from the first screen; nothing is added at checkout.
fees.perTicket: Charged per ticket on the face price; free tickets pay no fee.

absorb.name: Absorb
absorb.lead: the organiser pays it: the fan pays the face price.

pass_on.name: Pass on
pass_on.lead: the fan pays it: the all-in price is the face price plus the fee.

split.name: Split
split.lead: half each: the fan's half is rounded down, the organiser's up.

fees.exampleLead: A ticket with a face price of {price}:
fees.allIn: Amounts are computed per ticket in bani or cents, with the fee rounded half up.
fees.studioLead: The platform fee is published for everyone.
fees.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change the fee policy.
fees.onlyUnpublished: A change applies only to prices not yet published.
fees.eventOverrideHint: Each event can override this policy on its own page.
fees.usesOrganiser: This event uses the organisation's policy ({policy}).

pass.name: Pass by zone
pass.how: admits to a zone on every chosen day, for example a 4-day festival pass.

day_ticket.name: Day ticket
day_ticket.how: admits on one day: a set day, or the day the fan picks when buying.

flex_day.name: Flexible day
flex_day.how: the fan buys now and picks one of the allowed days later.

add_on.name: Add-on
add_on.how: an extra such as camping or parking, which can require a ticket in the same order.

voucher.name: Spend voucher
voucher.how: the ticket is worth a stated amount to spend on site, for example drinks.

table.name: Table by category
table.how: a table for a number of seats; the category sets the zone and view.

time_slot.name: Time slot
time_slot.how: a fixed-length slot between a first and last start, booked one or more in a row (padel).

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.lead: Tickets on EPS shops are sold by the organiser named on each shop. EPS runs the platform and shows every fee in the price.
terms.prototype: This is a prototype: no real payments are taken and no tickets are valid for entry.
terms.privacy: Privacy: shops built on EPS load pages, images and fonts from EPS only. They use no ads, no tracking and no third-party services; venue maps are static images saved from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors), so your browser never contacts a map service.
